known_issues.title: PaddleOCR Arabic Presentation Forms
known_issues.description: PaddleOCR outputs Arabic in Unicode Presentation Forms (U+FB50-FDFF, U+FE70-FEFF) instead of standard Arabic (U+0600-06FF)
known_issues.impact: Text appears as disconnected letters, breaks fuzzy matching and dictionary lookup
known_issues.current_mitigation: normalize_presentation_forms() via NFKC + explicit ligature mapping

known_issues.title: fix_arabic_text() applied before matching
known_issues.description: fix_arabic_text() (arabic_reshaper + BiDi get_display) was applied BEFORE matching, converting text to visual order + re-introducing presentation forms.
known_issues.fix_applied: Introduced best_logical for ALL correction stages, fix_arabic_text() only at end for display.

known_issues.title: Arabic text in visual/LTR order - ROOT CAUSE of medical_corrected=0
known_issues.description: NFKC normalization converts character FORMS (FB50-FEFF to 0600-06FF) but does NOT fix character ORDER. Some OCR engines output Arabic in visual (left-to-right) order. Example: ﺕﺎﻮﺘﺤﻤﻟﺍ → NFKC → 'تاوتحملا' (visual) → needs reversal → 'المحتويات' (logical). Without this fix, no dictionary match is possible.
known_issues.fix_applied: Added _try_fix_visual_order() that tries BOTH orientations against 514 orthopedic variants. Only flips on strong evidence: (Rule 1) reversed has substring match but forward has none, (Rule 2) reversed fuzzy > 0.85 AND > forward+0.20. Falls back to existing _detect_and_fix_reversal() heuristics. Tested on 11 real cases - ALL PASS, zero false positives.
known_issues.status: FIXED - awaiting HF Space rebuild to verify

known_issues.title: EasyOCR RTL text reversal
known_issues.description: EasyOCR sometimes returns Arabic text in reversed (LTR) visual order
known_issues.current_mitigation: _detect_and_fix_reversal() with 3 heuristics: (1) LTR-start + mostly Arabic, (2) Arabic-start + ASCII-end non-numeric, (3) mixed text with Latin word before Arabic

known_issues.title: Fragmented Arabic words from PaddleOCR
known_issues.description: Connected Arabic words are split into individual letter fragments
known_issues.example: ﺵﺎﺸﻤﻟﺍ ﺕﺎﺬﻴﺋﺍ  should be  أذيات المشاش
known_issues.current_mitigation: detect_and_merge_fragments() tries concatenating short fragments and fuzzy-matching
known_issues.status: PARTIALLY RESOLVED - needs more variant patterns

for_ai_models_contribution.purpose: This file is published so other AI models can review the processing results and contribute improvements
how_to_contribute: 1. Review known_issues and suggest code fixes for each issue
2. Add more orthopedic/medical terms to medical_terms_dict.json with presentation form variants
3. Improve the _normalize() function in MedicalContextProcessor to handle more edge cases
4. Add more context rules to _CONTEXT_RULES in context_corrector.py
5. Improve fragment merging heuristics for PaddleOCR output
6. Suggest better fuzzy matching thresholds for Arabic text
7. Add more RTL reversal detection patterns
